A rejected final guard therefore cannot publish the final index. The parent-reported external refusal regression was not executed by the reviewer.
scope: Static field/path/parser/publication review of the external current qualification index helper. No helper, test, native, build or network execution; no live checkpoint/log/receipt, database, authentication or configuration data read.
confirmed: QualificationReceipt exposes receipt_id/execution_id/checks/profile_hash/started_at/finished_at and execution_evidence with the fields used here.
validate_qualified_receipt binds the exact installed measured native subject, actual fixed profile, member sequence, counts, outcomes and committed artifact bytes before index construction.
Producer writes sanitized command logs as LF bytes before recording their SHA; the index's named-success parser matches that actual producer format, including unittest two-line method descriptions.
Each command log is protected-read, hash checked and parsed from the same captured raw bytes; exact member test-case sequence is required.

Source-only and native assertion observations are distinct; missing source definitions remain explicitly unresolved; timing is only the owning complete qualification window; no requirement PASS is issued.

resolved_findings.finding: The final execution-index file is written with PASS case rows and the original revision before the final _guard. If source, package or profile changes during indexing, the final guard raises but leaves a complete-looking final index published. The emitted index has no failed/provisional disposition distinguishing that rejected attempt.
resolved_findings.minimal_fix: Require final source/package/profile guards before opening the final exclusive output. If retaining an intermediate attempt, label it explicitly provisional/failed and keep it separate from the final index.
resolved_findings.minimal_regression: Force the final guard to reject after successful parsing and require no final execution-index file to exist; preserve existing successful-publication behavior.

limits: No actual receipt or current qualification success was inspected or inferred.
AST coordinates are static source-resolution observations, not an exhaustive semantic or dynamic-dispatch proof.
